summary: Refresh standard costing, ABC, CVP, and management reporting in 5 days. Build practical tools and sharpen cost decisions.
lede: Cost and management accounting helps finance professionals turn cost and performance data into decision support. For practitioners who already work with cost reports and budgets, the refresher covers standard costing and variance analysis, activity-based allocation, and cost-volume-profit and relevant-cost analysis for pricing and short-term decisions. Participants also practice budget-to-actual control and management reporting with KPIs.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with cost reports, budgets, and performance data and now need sharper decision support methods, stronger control techniques, and more credible management reporting.
prerequisites: Participants should have prior exposure to basic bookkeeping, financial statements, budgeting concepts, and spreadsheet use such as Microsoft Excel. A working knowledge of management accounting terminology is expected, but coding is not required. The course is delivered at an advanced refresher level, so you should already prepare to interpret cost reports, variance schedules, and decision models rather than learn accounting basics from scratch.
